introduction: In southern China, the demolition of a small village went quite well, as they always do. Two kids happened to get an abandoned wood-carved earth God. The story went on like a metaphor when temples around have no interest in this wood-carved earth God even the kids walked a long way, trying to return it. When back home, they were told this wood-carved earth God only worth the price of a can of coke. Finally, with an innocent heart, they bury the wood-carved earth God into the ground, praying for a better future for the land they are going to live with.
